			amount = 4
			AND = { owns_state = 124 owns_state = 125 }
			AND = { owns_state = 126 owns_state = 127 }
			AND = { owns_state = 128 owns_state = 1051 owns_state = 1052 owns_state = 1053 owns_state = 1054 owns_state = 129 }
			AND = { owns_state = 135 owns_state = 136 }
			OR = { AND = { owns_state = 134 } has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_mnt_counts_reunif }
			AND = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_kosovo_weight_half } owns_state = 133 }
		}
		OR = {
			AND = { owns_state = 130 owns_state = 998 }

		}
	}

				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = SOV }
			}
		}
	}
	SOV = {
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = SER }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_by_us value = SER }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = SER }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_by_us value = SER }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = SER }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_by_us value = SER }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = SER }
				is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_by_us value = SER }
			}
		}
	}
}
